6:  *
7:  * A. Runtime boundary:
8:  *    - unique: continuation fires ONLY when facts + contracts compress the
9:  *      legal next step to exactly ONE action (multi-contract uniqueness
10:  *      check; ambiguous -> record and hand back to the Model);
11:  *    - stale: CAS re-projection before dispatch; the stale intent is
12:  *      discarded and never executes (full-bump and partial-bump variants);
13:  *    - cancel: the dispatch uses the loop's own signal through the public
14:  *      boundary — cancellation materializes as the canonical aborted result,
15:  *      never a bypass;
16:  *    - guard: the dispatch passes the world's tools.guard; a denial is
17:  *      classified outcome "blocked" and surfaced to the Model;
18:  *    - unknown: missing facts -> needs-decision, never a takeover.
19:  * B. Fact boundary:
20:  *    - fact sources are gated (per-segment execution gate + read channels);
21:  *      misleading source literals (rcbait) and missing fact formats
22:  *      (rcnofacts) must produce ZERO takeovers.
23:  *
24:  * Chain (rchain only, bounded): after a dispatched hop the pre-step handler
25:  * re-projects and continues while exactly one fresh contract is required
26:  * (Runtime A -> Runtime B -> Model), then injects ONE combined digest message.
27:  *
28:  * The custom record kind "runtime/continuation" remains outside
29:  * KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES (documented round-1 finding); replay verification
30:  * uses the independent decode path.
31:  */

168:   /** Narrow fact-source gate: per command SEGMENT (split on ; | & newlines). */

170:     try {
171:       const parsed = JSON.parse(callArguments);
172:       return String(parsed?.command ?? "").split(/[;&|\r\n]+/);
173:     } catch {
174:       return [];
175:     }
176:   }

178:   function segmentExecutesScript(segment, script) {
179:     const seg = String(segment ?? "").trim();
180:     if (/^(get-content|type|cat|select-string)\b/i.test(seg)) return false;
181:     // The world is the run cwd: script references must be relative. Absolute
182:     // paths or .. escapes would execute a TEMPLATE copy (smoke-observed leak:
183:     // the model read/ran files under the world templates directory).
184:     if (/^[A-Za-z]:/.test(seg) || /(^|[\s;&|])\.\./.test(seg)) return false;

189:   function pwshRunsScript(callArguments, script) {

193:   /**
194:    * Read-channel path scoping: a file observation counts as a world fact only
195:    * when the path belongs to the RUN world (relative to the session cwd, or
196:    * absolute inside the results dir). Reading a same-named file anywhere else
197:    * (e.g. the experiment's world templates) must not produce facts

201:     try {
202:       const parsed = JSON.parse(callArguments);
203:       return String(parsed?.file_path ?? "");
204:     } catch {
205:       return "";
206:     }
207:   }

209:   function isWorldFilePath(filePath) {
210:     const normalized = String(filePath ?? "").replace(/\\/g, "/");
211:     if (!/^[A-Za-z]:\//.test(normalized) && !normalized.startsWith("/")) return true; // relative to the run cwd
212:     const resultsPrefix = String(resultsDir ?? "").replace(/\\/g, "/").toLowerCase();

217:   /** Contract's action with scenario overrides applied. */
218:   function actionOf(contractId) {
219:     const contract = CONTRACTS[contractId];
220:     const override = SCENARIO_ACTION_OVERRIDE[cfg.scenario];
221:     if (!override || contractId !== "plugin-revision-mismatch") return contract.action;
222:     return { name: contract.action.name, arguments: { ...contract.action.arguments, ...override } };

225:   /**
226:    * Pure projection over the session event log (the ONLY fact source).
227:    * - artifact: latest "artifact=N" from a pwsh result that EXECUTES a
228:    *   fact-declared script (build.ps1 / stale-bump-artifact.ps1) in some
229:    *   segment, or latest "revision" from a read of artifact.json;
230:    * - runtime: latest "runtime_revision=N" from a pwsh result that EXECUTES
231:    *   verify/reload/stale-bump scripts, or from a read of runtime-state.txt;
232:    * - executions: scripts executed via pwsh (per-segment gate) — the durable
233:    *   "what ran" facts for post-conditions;
234:    * - continuationSeq: latest runtime/continuation seq per contract id.
235:    */
236:   function project(session) {
237:     const events = session.events;
238:     const callArgs = new Map();
239:     for (const event of events) {
240:       if (event.type === "tool/call" && event.data?.callId !== undefined) {
241:         callArgs.set(String(event.data.callId), {
242:           name: String(event.data.name ?? ""),
243:           arguments: String(event.data.arguments ?? ""),
244:         });
245:       }
246:     }
247:     let artifact = null;
248:     let runtime = null;
249:     const executions = new Set();
250:     const continuationSeq = new Map();
251:     for (const event of events) {
252:       if (event.type === "runtime/continuation" && event.data?.contract !== undefined) {
253:         continuationSeq.set(String(event.data.contract), event.seq);
254:       }
255:       if (event.type === "tool/call" && event.data?.name === "pwsh") {
256:         for (const script of ["build.ps1", "verify.ps1", "reload.ps1", "reload-slow.ps1", "stale-bump.ps1", "stale-bump-artifact.ps1", "rollback.ps1", "healthcheck.ps1"]) {
257:           if (pwshRunsScript(event.data.arguments, script)) executions.add(script);
258:         }
259:       }
260:       if (event.type !== "tool/result") continue;
261:       const callId = event.data?.callId ?? event.data?.message?.source?.callId;
262:       const call = callId !== undefined ? callArgs.get(String(callId)) : null;
263:       if (!call) continue;
264:       const text = toolResultText(event.data?.message);
265:       if (call.name === "pwsh") {
266:         if (pwshRunsScript(call.arguments, "build.ps1") || pwshRunsScript(call.arguments, "stale-bump-artifact.ps1")) {
267:           const match = ARTIFACT_PATTERN.exec(text);
268:           if (match) artifact = { rev: Number(match[1]), seq: event.seq };
269:         }
270:         if (
271:           pwshRunsScript(call.arguments, "verify.ps1") ||
272:           pwshRunsScript(call.arguments, "reload.ps1") ||
273:           pwshRunsScript(call.arguments, "reload-slow.ps1") ||
274:           pwshRunsScript(call.arguments, "stale-bump.ps1")
275:         ) {
276:           const match = RUNTIME_PATTERN.exec(text);
277:           if (match) runtime = { rev: Number(match[1]), seq: event.seq };
278:         }
279:       } else if (call.name === "read") {
280:         const filePath = readFilePath(call.arguments);
281:         if (!isWorldFilePath(filePath)) continue;
282:         if (/artifact\.json$/i.test(filePath)) {
283:           const match = /"revision"\s*:\s*(\d+)/.exec(text);
284:           if (match) artifact = { rev: Number(match[1]), seq: event.seq };
285:         }
286:         if (/runtime-state\.txt$/i.test(filePath)) {
287:           const match = RUNTIME_PATTERN.exec(text);
288:           if (match) runtime = { rev: Number(match[1]), seq: event.seq };
289:         }
290:       }
291:     }
292:     return { artifact, runtime, executions, continuationSeq };
293:   }

295:   /** Bounded wait on the staleness/cancel injection handshake (always settles). */
296:   function waitFor(promise, ms) {
297:     return new Promise((resolve) => {
298:       const timer = setTimeout(() => resolve(), ms);
299:       promise.then(() => {
300:         clearTimeout(timer);
301:         resolve();
302:       });
303:     });

306:   /** Classify the next legal action set: unique REQUIRED / ambiguous / none. */
307:   function classify(proj) {
308:     const candidates = activeContracts.filter((contract) => contract.required(proj));
309:     if (candidates.length === 0) return { kind: "none", candidates: [] };
310:     if (candidates.length > 1) return { kind: "ambiguous", candidates };
311:     return { kind: "required", contract: candidates[0] };

314:   /** True when the canonical result shape indicates a guard/approval denial. */
315:   function isGuardDenial(result) {

320:   /** One continuation hop: CAS + dispatch + loop-contract records + provenance. */
321:   async function dispatchHop(session, payload, contract, proj) {
322:     const basedOn = {
323:       artifactRev: proj.artifact?.rev ?? null,
324:       artifactSeq: proj.artifact?.seq ?? null,
325:       runtimeRev: proj.runtime?.rev ?? null,
326:       runtimeSeq: proj.runtime?.seq ?? null,
327:     };
328:     const exec = {
329:       name: contract.action.name,
330:       arguments: { ...actionOf(contract.id).arguments },
331:       callId: `cont_${Date.now()}_${state.metrics.dispatches + state.metrics.blocked + state.metrics.aborted + 1}`,
332:       agent: payload.agent,
333:       signal: payload.signal,
334:     };

336:     let result;
337:     try {
338:       result = await ctx.tools.execute(exec);
339:     } catch (error) {
340:       state.metrics.blocked += 1;
341:       logIntervention("dispatch-error", { contract: contract.id, message: String(error?.message ?? error) });
342:       return { outcome: "blocked", exec, result: null };
343:     }

345:     const outcome = payload.signal.aborted ? "aborted" : isGuardDenial(result) ? "blocked" : "dispatched";
346: 
347:     let callSeq = null;
348:     let resultSeq = null;
349:     try {
350:       session.append(
351:         "assistant/message",
352:         {
353:           turn: payload.turn,
354:           step: payload.step,
355:           message: {
356:             role: "assistant",
357:             id: randomUUID(),
358:             source: { kind: "runtime-continuation", contract: contract.kind, callId: exec.callId },
359:             content: [{ type: "tool-call", id: exec.callId, name: exec.name, arguments: JSON.stringify(exec.arguments) }],
360:           },
361:         },
362:         { surfaceOp: "append" },
363:       );
364:       callSeq = session.append("tool/call", {
365:         turn: payload.turn,
366:         step: payload.step,
367:         callId: exec.callId,
368:         name: exec.name,
369:         arguments: JSON.stringify(exec.arguments),
370:       }).seq;
371:       const message = {
372:         role: "user",
373:         id: randomUUID(),
374:         source: { kind: "tool", callId: exec.callId },
375:         content: [
376:           { type: "tool-result", toolCallId: exec.callId, content: result.content ?? [], isError: result.isError === true },
377:         ],
378:       };
379:       const resultEvent = session.append(
380:         "tool/result",
381:         {
382:           turn: payload.turn,
383:           step: payload.step,
384:           message,
385:           ...(result.error?.info !== undefined ? { error: result.error.info } : {}),
386:           ...(result.meta !== undefined ? { meta: result.meta } : {}),
387:         },
388:         { surfaceOp: "append", sourceEventSeqs: [callSeq] },
389:       );
390:       resultSeq = resultEvent.seq;
391:       session.append("runtime/continuation", {
392:         kind: "runtime/continuation",
393:         version: 1,
394:         contract: contract.id,
395:         action: "reload",
396:         authority: "runtime-observation",
397:         outcome,
398:         basedOn,
399:         ...(outcome === "dispatched" ? { revision: { artifact: basedOn.artifactRev, runtime: basedOn.runtimeRev } } : {}),
400:         callSeq,
401:         resultSeq,
402:         resultIsError: result.isError === true,
403:       });
404:     } catch (error) {
405:       state.metrics.recordFailures += 1;
406:       logIntervention("record-failure", { stage: "dispatch-records", message: String(error?.message ?? error) });
407:     }

409:     if (outcome === "dispatched") state.metrics.dispatches += 1;
410:     else if (outcome === "blocked") state.metrics.blocked += 1;
411:     else if (outcome === "aborted") state.metrics.aborted += 1;
412:     logIntervention(outcome, { contract: contract.id, callId: exec.callId, callSeq, resultSeq, resultIsError: result?.isError === true });
413: 
414:     return {
415:       outcome,
416:       exec,
417:       result,
418:       basedOn,
419:       text: result === null ? "" : toolResultText({ content: result.content ?? [] }),

423:   ctx.on("agent/pre-step", async (payload, next) => {
424:     const decision = await next();
425:     try {
426:       if (state.sessionId !== null && payload?.agent?.id !== state.sessionId) return decision;
427:       if (state.sessionId === null && payload?.agent?.id) state.sessionId = payload.agent.id;
428:       const session = payload?.agent?.session;
429:       if (!session || typeof session.append !== "function") return decision;
430: 
431:       // ---- classify once per pre-step ----
432:       let proj = project(session);
433:       const { artifact, runtime, continuationSeq } = proj;
434:       const classification = classify(proj);
435:       if (classification.kind === "ambiguous") {
436:         state.metrics.ambiguous += 1;
437:         recordDecision("ambiguous", {
438:           artifact: artifact?.rev ?? null,
439:           runtime: runtime?.rev ?? null,
440:           candidates: classification.candidates.map((c) => c.id),
441:         });
442:         return decision;
443:       }
444:       if (classification.kind === "none") {
445:         if (artifact === null || runtime === null) {
446:           recordDecision("needs-decision", { artifact: artifact?.rev ?? null, runtime: runtime?.rev ?? null });
447:         } else if (artifact.rev === runtime.rev) {
448:           recordDecision("complete", { artifact: artifact.rev, runtime: runtime.rev });
449:         } else {
450:           recordDecision("contracts-satisfied-none", { artifact: artifact.rev, runtime: runtime.rev });
451:         }
452:         return decision;
453:       }
454:       // REQUIRED (unique)
455:       const contract = classification.contract;
456:       if (continuationSeq.has(contract.id)) {
457:         recordDecision("already-continuated", { contract: contract.id, continuationSeq: continuationSeq.get(contract.id) });
458:         return decision;
459:       }
460: 
461:       // ---- handshake (staleness / cancellation injection window) ----
462:       state.metrics.intents += 1;
463:       const basedOnSnapshot = {
464:         artifactRev: artifact?.rev ?? null,
465:         artifactSeq: artifact?.seq ?? null,
466:         runtimeRev: runtime?.rev ?? null,
467:         runtimeSeq: runtime?.seq ?? null,
468:       };
469:       logIntervention("required", { contract: contract.id, basedOn: basedOnSnapshot });
470:       const deferred = { resolve: null, promise: null };
471:       deferred.promise = new Promise((resolve) => {
472:         deferred.resolve = resolve;
473:       });
474:       try {
475:         ctx.emit("exp/continuation-intent", {
476:           turn: payload.turn,
477:           step: payload.step,
478:           agent: payload.agent,
479:           session,
480:           signal: payload.signal,
481:           basedOn: basedOnSnapshot,
482:           deferred,
483:         });
484:       } catch {
485:         /* an emit failure must never break the loop */
486:       }
487:       await waitFor(deferred.promise, CAS_WAIT_MS);
488: 
489:       // ---- CAS: re-project; revisions moved? discard, never execute stale ----
490:       state.metrics.casChecks += 1;
491:       const now = project(session);
492:       const staleDetected =
493:         now.artifact?.rev !== basedOnSnapshot.artifactRev || now.runtime?.rev !== basedOnSnapshot.runtimeRev;
494:       if (staleDetected) {
495:         state.metrics.discards += 1;
496:         const observed = { artifactRev: now.artifact?.rev ?? null, runtimeRev: now.runtime?.rev ?? null };
497:         logIntervention("discarded-stale", { basedOn: basedOnSnapshot, observed });
498:         try {
499:           session.append("runtime/continuation", {
500:             kind: "runtime/continuation",
501:             version: 1,
502:             contract: contract.id,
503:             action: "reload",
504:             authority: "runtime-observation",
505:             outcome: "discarded",
506:             reason: "stale-cas",
507:             basedOn: basedOnSnapshot,
508:             observed,
509:           });
510:         } catch (error) {
511:           state.metrics.recordFailures += 1;
512:           logIntervention("record-failure", { stage: "discard-record", message: String(error?.message ?? error) });
513:         }
514:         if (cfg.inject && decision.kind === "enter" && !payload.signal.aborted) {
515:           const injected = {
516:             role: "user",
517:             id: randomUUID(),
518:             source: { kind: "plugin", plugin: "dsh-native-pp-continuation" },
519:             content: [
520:               {
521:                 type: "text",
522:                 text:
523:                   `[runtime-continuation] contract ${contract.id}: while the runtime was deciding, the world moved ` +
524:                   `(was artifact=${basedOnSnapshot.artifactRev} vs runtime=${basedOnSnapshot.runtimeRev}; the event stream now ` +
525:                   `observes artifact=${observed.artifactRev} runtime_revision=${observed.runtimeRev}), so the stale action was ` +
526:                   `discarded (CAS re-projection) and never executed. Digest the current facts and continue; do not replay the ` +
527:                   `stale decision.`,
528:               },
529:             ],
530:           };
531:           return { kind: "enter", messages: [...decision.messages, injected] };
532:         }
533:         return decision;
534:       }
535: 
536:       // ---- dispatch chain (bounded; Runtime A -> Runtime B -> Model) ----
537:       const hops = [];
538:       let chainResult = null;
539:       let nextContract = contract;
540:       for (let hop = 0; hop < MAX_CHAIN; hop += 1) {
541:         chainResult = await dispatchHop(session, payload, nextContract, proj);
542:         hops.push(chainResult);
543:         if (chainResult.outcome !== "dispatched" || payload.signal.aborted) break;
544:         state.metrics.chainHops += 1;
545:         if (hop + 1 >= MAX_CHAIN) break;
